free_tier.notes: The free path is not byte-metered; it is shaped. 586 KB/s is 50.6 GB/day, or about 1.5 TB/month if the client leaves the machine running.

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable: the free account has no cloud drive add-on queue to cap.

retention.stated: Not applicable: the free path downloads to a user's own disk, nothing is stored server-side.

egress.terms: Unmetered and shaped. The vendor table puts the un-membered path at 586 KB/s against 15.8 MB/s for 超级会员, a 27x difference on the same file.

interface_detail: The same vendor client, without the membership features.
tooling: Vendor client; the free path is a user's ordinary HTTP/BT downloader.
chaining: The free path is the fallback when no membership is held: 1.5 TB/month is reachable in principle, but only by leaving a machine on for the whole month, and a magnet never becomes a server-side task.

limits.value: 586 KB/s per the vendor speed table; no byte counter

identity_cost.detail: Same account system as 超级会员: phone plus 微信/QQ QR. Unverified beyond that.

reliability_note: The 27x gap is the product. Nothing about the free path is capped in bytes, so a user's own bandwidth and patience are the only limit.
confidence_note: A timed download on a free account would make it measured.

evidence.proved: '586 KB/s' in the vendor's 超级会员速度揭秘 table for the un-membered tier; page returned 403
'离线下载及高速通道加速已整合为会员加速功能，超级会员是支持的哦。' - the function is now membership-only

notes: Free-tier retrieval through 迅雷 is not a debrid-equivalent: there is no server-side fetch. The value of this record is the 27x number, which prices every other accelerator in the market.
binding_note: The free path can technically move 1.5 TB/month, so the 586 KB/s shaping is not what fails at 1 TiB/month; what fails is the absence of any cloud-add quota, which makes server-side retrieval of a magnet impossible at any speed. Recorded as per-ip-shaping because it is the measurable ceiling.
